lines.welcome: Welcome, sound detective! Listen to the coral shaker, then find its sound twin.
lines.find: Now tap an aqua shaker. Which one sounds the same?
lines.different: Those sound different. Listen to the coral shaker again.
lines.round-two: Wonderful listening. Here comes a new mystery sound.
lines.round-three: Your listening ears are ready for another one.
lines.idle-reference: Tap the coral shaker to hear it again.
lines.idle-candidate: Try an aqua shaker and listen for the same sound.
lines.complete: You matched every sound! Your listening ears are amazing.
